main_text.p: honestis & licitis. Archiep. Satis tu quidem arroganter hæc, ratus te ac tui similes solos esse iustos, itaque Pauli doctrinam respuentes, putatis licere quod libet. Guilhel. Obsecro quos tu potissimum Apostolorum munus nobis in ecclesia referre iudicas, an non sacerdotes? Archie. Maxime quidē. Guilhel. Primum ergo de Apostolorum officio, abun deliquet, Matthei 10. & Marci ultimo: Christus misit prædicare Apostolos. Præterea Lucæ 10. ubi legimus à Christo 72 discipulos, ad confirmandum ablegatos in omnem ciuitatem, & locum quo fuerat ipse uenturus. Quemadmodum nec Gregorius dissimulat, in decretis scribes, prædicationis officium cum sacerdotio esse commune. Presbiter, inquit ille, ad iracundiam dominum prouocat, cuius in Euangelij prædicatione, uocem populus non audit. Et Glossa in Ezechielem. Sacerdos

page.notes: Catchword "cerdos" set at the lower right, below the last line. Some words are doubtful in the scan, notably "confirmandum" and "Euangelij", which may be misread. Show-through from the facing page is visible at the right and was left out.
